MateConnection.title: MateConnection
MateConnection.description: Mate connections between users with social handles and optional shoutout

id.description: Unique identifier for the mate connection

userId.description: UID of the user who initiated or owns the connection

targetName.description: Display name of the target connection

socialHandles.description: Map of connected social handles: instagram, tiktok, snapchat, discord, x, whatsapp, spotify

showOnFeed.description: Whether to broadcast this mate connection to the public community feed

shoutout.description: Optional custom street art shoutout message

FeedPost.title: FeedPost
FeedPost.description: Derived feed post from opted-in Mate connections with reactions

id.description: Unique identifier of the feed post

createdAt.description: Unix timestamp of the feed post

mateConnectionId.description: Reference ID of the source mate connection

userHandle.description: Display name or @handle of the poster

targetName.description: Display name of the connected mate

targetPhotoUrl.description: URL of the connected mate's photo

reactions.description: Map of reaction counts: hi, drip, cheers

PassedIds.title: PassedIds
PassedIds.description: Passed photo card IDs per user for feed and deck exclusion

ids.description: List of string IDs of cards the user has passed on

/feedPosts/{feedPostId}.description: Public community feed posts derived from opted-in mate connections

/passedIds/{userId}.description: Array of passed card IDs for each user, mirrored in localStorage
